```{r}


summarize_dat <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    summarise(
      # T_encode
      mean_T_encode     = mean(cat_practice_question.stopped - cat_practice_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_T_encode       = sd(cat_practice_question.stopped   - cat_practice_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # RT_onset
      mean_RT_onset     = mean(key_resp_8.rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_onset       = sd(key_resp_8.rt,   na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # RT_critical
      mean_RT_critical  = mean(key_resp_8.rt - critical_time, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_critical    = sd(key_resp_8.rt   - critical_time, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # ACC
      mean_ACC          = mean(key_resp_8.corr, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_ACC            = sd(key_resp_8.corr,   na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # IES_onset
      mean_IES_onset    = mean(key_resp_8.rt / mean(key_resp_8.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_onset      = sd(key_resp_8.rt   / mean(key_resp_8.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # IES_critical
      mean_IES_critical = mean((key_resp_8.rt - critical_time) / mean(key_resp_8.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_critical   = sd((key_resp_8.rt   - critical_time) / mean(key_resp_8.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# 生成每个dat的summary table
```
